meta.move: Long messages with curly quotes and a concession
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste the time. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and did anyone speak to him first?

I want to be fair to Owen. I compared the essay with his in-class writing from September 24: 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices throughout, no quotations. This essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line, and none of those errors.

Okay. I'm writing down September 24, 380 words in 40 minutes. Timed in-class writing against an essay done over a weekend is a different thing, so show me both pages, and you still haven't said whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero went in.
You’re right that the checker alone proves nothing. I’m taking it off the table. I’m relying on the writing and the version history.
Okay, Hale. I'm writing down that the checker is off the table. What does the version history show, and whose account is it from?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You told me today that you are taking the checker off the table and relying on the writing and the version history. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the version history and the September 24 writing sample in front of me, with dates. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, with nothing agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to see both writing samples and the version history.
What moved her: Hale dropped the detector score and named a dated in-class writing sample with exact numbers, which earned a little attention, though she has not seen the pages yet.
What cost ground: Hale never answered whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero was entered, which left her on the procedure complaint the whole time.
Try next time: Right after the writing comparison, say in one sentence that the zero went in before any call home, then offer to put both pages in front of her.
